title: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame
author: Victor Hugo
current_text: The novel was placed on the Index in 1834.

sources.quote: Considéré comme une lecture pernicieuse par l'Église catholique, Notre-Dame de Paris fait partie des romans mis à l' Index en 1834
sources.title: Notre-Dame de Paris (roman) - Wikipédia

ban_rows.note: Added to the Index in 1834 for its portrayal of corrupt clergy and anti-clerical subtext. On the Index until 1966.
The 19th-century French classic was among the ~4,390 titles barred by Kuwait's Ministry of Information censorship committee (2014–2018).
